Record the effective date the amendment applies from.
Attach the source bulletin to the checklist record.
Done when every amended line carries citation and date.
verify: List amended lines with no citation or effective date.
Pass when every amended line carries both values.

steps.title: Increment the version and supersede the prior checklist
sop: Increment the checklist version number.
Mark the prior version superseded and archive it.
Write the change summary onto the new version.
Done when the new version is issued and the old archived.
verify: Search the published location for prior versions.
Pass when only the current version is published.

steps.title: Reassess in-market materials approved under the old version
sop: List materials approved under the old checklist still in market.
Reassess each against the amended lines.
Record the reassessment outcome and any remediation raised.
Done when every affected in-market material is reassessed.
verify: List in-market materials with no reassessment record.
Pass when every affected in-market material has been reassessed.

steps.title: Notify reviewers and record acknowledgements
sop: Notify all advertising reviewers of the checklist change.
Request acknowledgement from each reviewer.
Chase reviewers who have not acknowledged.
Done when every reviewer has acknowledged or been chased.
verify: List reviewers with no acknowledgement recorded.
Pass when every reviewer acknowledgement is recorded.

steps.title: Confirm every implemented rule change has a checklist update
sop: List rule changes implemented in the period.
Join them to the checklist amendments made.
Raise a gap for any change with no amendment.
Done when every change maps to an amendment or a justified gap.
verify: Re-run the join after the gaps are closed.
Pass when no implemented rule change is missing a checklist update.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every named producer appearing in producer-branded advertising.
generic.In-scope period: The campaign flight from first-use date to the campaign end date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each check records licence number, states, appointment status and expiry date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Verified producer count matches the producers named in the creative.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Licence verification extract filed and dated with the campaign approval.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Producers failing verification are logged and removed from the creative.
generic.Test population: All named producers across all advertised states in the campaign.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every named producer holds an active licence and appointment per state.
generic.Exception handling path: A licence expiring mid-flight blocks the ad until renewed or the name is removed.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: No producer-branded ad is approved without a dated licence verification record.
generic.Evidence location: Compliance evidence repository verification file and the producer system record.

steps.title: Look up each named producer in the licensing source
sop: List producers named in the creative and the states the ad will run.
Look each up in NIPR for licence status per state.
Record licence number and status per producer and state.
Done when every producer and state combination is checked.
verify: Compare checked combinations to the producer and state list.
Pass when every named producer holds an active licence in every state.

steps.title: Confirm appointment with the underwriting company
sop: Open the agency or producer management system record for each producer.
Confirm an active appointment for the advertised product line.
Record the appointment status and effective date.
Done when every producer has an appointment status recorded.
verify: List producers with no active appointment for the product line.
Pass when every named producer holds an active appointment.

steps.title: Check licence expiry against the campaign end date
sop: Compare each licence expiry date to the campaign end date.
Flag licences expiring mid-flight.
Agree removal or renewal for each flagged producer.
Done when every expiry is compared and flagged where needed.
verify: List producers whose licence expires before campaign end.
Pass when no flagged producer remains in the approved creative.

steps.title: Match creative producer details to the licensing record
sop: Compare producer name and licence number shown in the creative.
Match them exactly to the licensing record values.
Correct any mismatch in the creative before approval.
Done when creative details match the licensing record.
verify: Re-compare the corrected creative to the licensing record.
Pass when name and licence number match exactly.

steps.title: File the licence verification evidence
sop: Capture the licence verification extract or screenshot.
File it with the campaign approval evidence.
Date the evidence and record the verifier name.
Done when the dated verification evidence is filed.
verify: Open the filed verification evidence.
Pass when the evidence carries a date and verifier name.

steps.title: Record the verification outcome against the ad approval
sop: Record the verification outcome on the advertising approval record.
Block approval where any producer failed verification.
Note the removed or replaced producers.
Done when the approval record shows the verification outcome.
verify: Open the approval record for the producer-branded ad.
Pass when a dated licence verification record is attached.

generic.Defined scope/population: All required disclosures, suitability statements and producer identification in the material.
generic.In-scope period: The verification cycle for the submitted material version.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each disclosure line records library reference, outcome and reviewer name.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Verified disclosure count matches the required disclosures for the campaign type.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Verification record stored with the disclosure library version used.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Wording deviations are logged with the correction or the accepted rationale.
generic.Test population: All disclosures present or required in the submitted material.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No required disclosure is missing, reworded or below the legibility standard.
generic.Exception handling path: A deviation routes back to the copy owner before approval proceeds.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Each required disclosure is matched to its approved library reference.
generic.Evidence location: Compliance evidence repository verification record and the GRC checklist result.

steps.title: Compare each disclosure to the approved library text
sop: Locate each disclosure in the material.
Compare the wording to the approved disclosure library text.
Flag every wording deviation with its location.
Done when every disclosure has a comparison outcome.
verify: Re-read the flagged deviations against the library text.
Pass when no required disclosure is reworded from the library text.

steps.title: Confirm suitability statements accompany recommendations
sop: Find every product recommendation or comparison in the material.
Confirm a suitability statement accompanies each.
Flag recommendations with no suitability statement.
Done when every recommendation has an outcome recorded.
verify: List recommendations with no suitability statement.
Pass when every recommendation carries a suitability statement.

steps.title: Verify producer identification and underwriting company details
sop: Check producer identification and licence reference are present.
Check the underwriting company details are correct.
Flag any missing or incorrect element.
Done when identification elements are verified.
verify: Compare the shown details to the company and producer records.
Pass when producer and underwriter details are present and correct.

steps.title: Check legibility, contrast and placement per medium
sop: Assess font size, contrast and placement in each medium used.
Compare against the clear and conspicuous requirement.
Flag disclosures failing the standard.
Done when every disclosure has a legibility outcome.
verify: Re-inspect flagged disclosures in the rendered medium.
Pass when no disclosure renders below the legibility standard.

steps.title: Record verification per line with library reference and reviewer
sop: Record the outcome per disclosure line.
Record the library reference used for the comparison.
Record the reviewer name and verification date.
Done when every line has outcome, reference and reviewer.
verify: Filter the record for lines missing a reference or reviewer.
Pass when every line records its library reference and reviewer.

steps.title: Route deviations for correction and file the record
sop: Send flagged deviations to the copy owner with the required wording.
Confirm the correction target date.
File the verification record in the evidence repository.
Done when deviations are routed and the record filed.
verify: Open the filed verification record and routing entry.
Pass when every deviation is routed with the required wording stated.

generic.Defined scope/population: The approved annual marketing budget envelope across channels, campaigns and martech.
generic.In-scope period: The budget year the allocation takes effect in.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each allocation line records cost centre, owner, amount and category.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Loaded budget lines total exactly the approved envelope by cost centre.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Allocation approval recorded with approver, date and version in the budget file.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any unallocated residual is logged with a decision before load.
generic.Test population: All allocation lines loaded into the general ledger budget.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero allocated lines missing a cost centre or an owner.
generic.Exception handling path: An over-allocation is corrected before the ledger load proceeds.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Loaded budget lines total exactly the approved envelope by cost centre.
generic.Evidence location: ERP budget lines and the SharePoint allocation planning workbook.

steps.title: Split the envelope across channels, campaigns and martech
sop: Take the approved envelope and split it by channel, campaign and martech.
Code each line to its cost centre.
Record the split in the planning workbook.
Done when the full envelope is split into coded lines.
verify: Check each line for a cost centre code.
Pass when no allocated line is missing a cost centre.

steps.title: Reserve committed martech renewal amounts first
sop: List committed martech renewals due in the budget year.
Reserve the committed amounts before discretionary allocation.
Record the committed reserve on the planning sheet.
Done when committed renewals are reserved.
verify: Compare reserved amounts to the contract renewal schedule.
Pass when every committed renewal is reserved at contract value.

steps.title: Assign an owner to each allocation line
sop: Assign a named owner to every allocation line.
Confirm the owner accepts accountability for the spend.
Record the owner on the planning sheet.
Done when every line has a named owner.
verify: Filter allocation lines for a blank owner.
Pass when no allocated line is missing an owner.

steps.title: Reconcile the allocation to the approved envelope
sop: Sum the allocations across all lines.
Compare the total to the approved envelope.
Resolve any unallocated or over-allocated residual.
Done when the allocation totals to the envelope.
verify: Compare the allocation total to the envelope by cost centre.
Pass when the totals agree exactly by cost centre.

steps.title: Load the allocation into the general ledger budget lines
sop: Load the coded allocation into the ERP budget lines.
Compare the loaded values to the planning sheet.
Correct any load difference.
Done when the loaded budget matches the planning sheet.
verify: Extract the loaded budget by cost centre.
Pass when loaded lines total exactly the approved envelope.

steps.title: Record the allocation approval
sop: Review the allocation against the approved envelope and priorities.
Approve the allocation version and record the date.
File the approval with the budget file.
Done when the approval is recorded and filed.
verify: Open the budget file approval record.
Pass when approver, date and version are all recorded.

generic.Defined scope/population: The annual marketing budget request across all channels and committed spend.
generic.In-scope period: The budget year the request covers.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each line records channel, committed or discretionary flag, amount and assumption.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Bottom-up channel totals equal the headline request figure.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Request filed with its assumption set, scenarios and preparation date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Lines with unsupported assumptions are logged and revised or removed.
generic.Test population: All budget lines included in the submitted request.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No budget line is included without a volume or efficiency assumption.
generic.Exception handling path: An unsupported assumption returns the line to the channel owner.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Request shows committed versus discretionary split, assumptions and volumes.
generic.Evidence location: SharePoint budget request workbook and the BI CAC evidence extract.

steps.title: Build the request bottom-up by channel using prior-year CAC
sop: Take prior-year CAC by channel from the BI dataset.
Apply the division new-business volume targets to derive channel spend.
Record the derivation per channel.
Done when every channel line is derived bottom-up.
verify: Recompute two channel lines from CAC and volume target.
Pass when both lines recompute to the requested amount.

steps.title: Separate committed from discretionary spend
sop: Flag martech contracts and agency retainers as committed.
Flag campaign spend as discretionary.
Total each category separately.
Done when every line carries a committed or discretionary flag.
verify: Filter lines with no category flag.
Pass when every budget line is categorised.

steps.title: State cost inflation and media rate assumptions with sources
sop: State the assumed cost inflation rate and its source.
State the assumed media rate change and its source.
Record both in the assumption set.
Done when both assumptions are stated with sources.
verify: Read the assumption set for cited sources.
Pass when both assumptions carry a named source.

steps.title: Show expected lead, quote and policy volumes per line
sop: Derive expected lead, quote and policy volume for each budget line.
Record the volumes beside the requested amount.
Flag lines with no volume expectation.
Done when every line shows expected volumes.
verify: Filter lines with no stated volume or efficiency assumption.
Pass when no budget line is missing its volume assumption.

steps.title: Build base, upside and downside scenarios
sop: Build the base case from the bottom-up lines.
Build upside and downside variants with their volume consequences.
Record the trigger for each scenario.
Done when all three scenarios are built.
verify: Read the three scenarios and their volume outcomes.
Pass when each scenario states its volume consequence.

steps.title: Review and endorse the request for submission
sop: Review the request, assumptions and scenarios.
Challenge lines with weak volume support.
Endorse the request and record the endorsement date.
Done when the request is endorsed for submission.
verify: Open the endorsement record on the request.
Pass when the endorsement names the approver and the version.

generic.Defined scope/population: All marketing cost centres with actual plus committed spend in the period.
generic.In-scope period: The period-to-date position against the phased budget.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each flagged line records amount, cause classification and escalation owner.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Actual plus commitment totals tie to the ledger and open purchase orders.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Overrun escalations recorded in the budget tracker with dates.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Timing-only overruns are logged and closed with the phasing explanation.
generic.Test population: All budget lines in the marketing cost centres for the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every line breaching the overrun threshold is flagged with a cause.
generic.Exception handling path: A genuine overrun escalates to the budget holder with corrective action.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Every line breaching the threshold is flagged with a cause classification.
generic.Evidence location: ERP ledger extract and the marketing budget tracker.

steps.title: Compare actual plus committed spend to the phased budget
sop: Extract period-to-date actuals by marketing cost centre.
Add open commitments from purchase orders.
Compare the total to the phased budget per line.
Done when every line has a comparison result.
verify: Compare the extract total to the ledger and purchase order balances.
Pass when the extract reconciles to the ledger and commitments.

steps.title: Flag lines breaching the overrun threshold
sop: Apply the agreed overrun threshold to each line.
Flag every breaching line with its amount.
List the flagged lines for classification.
Done when every breaching line is flagged.
verify: Recompute the breach list from the comparison data.
Pass when the flagged list matches the computed breaches.

steps.title: Classify each overrun as timing or genuine
sop: Check accrual and invoice phasing behind each flagged line.
Classify the overrun as timing or genuine.
Record the classification and supporting reason.
Done when every flagged line is classified.
verify: List flagged lines with no classification.
Pass when every flagged line carries a cause classification.

steps.title: Escalate genuine overruns to the budget holder
sop: Prepare the escalation with amount, cause and proposed action.
Send it to the budget holder for each genuine overrun.
Record the escalation date and recipient.
Done when every genuine overrun is escalated.
verify: List genuine overruns with no escalation record.
Pass when no flagged overrun is left without an escalation.

steps.title: Agree corrective action per escalated overrun
sop: Agree the corrective action with the budget holder.
Record the action, its owner and the review date.
Confirm the action is achievable within the period.
Done when every escalation carries an agreed action.
verify: Open the tracker entries for the escalations.
Pass when every escalation records an agreed action and owner.

steps.title: Record escalations and actions in the budget tracker
sop: Write the escalations, causes and actions into the budget tracker.
Set a review date on each open item.
Publish the tracker to marketing leadership.
Done when the tracker reflects every escalation.
verify: Open the tracker and compare it to the escalation list.
Pass when every escalation appears with an owner and review date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Forward-looking marketing spend risks affecting the budget envelope.
generic.In-scope period: The remaining budget period the risks could materialise in.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each risk records best case, worst case, likelihood and mitigation position.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Quantified risk range reconciles to the committed and contracted exposure.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Risk summary sent to finance with the send date recorded.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Risks needing additional funding are logged separately with a decision.
generic.Test population: All identified spend risks for the remaining period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every risk carries a quantified range, likelihood and mitigation position.
generic.Exception handling path: A risk with no finance response is chased before the next reporting window.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Each risk carries a quantified range, likelihood and mitigation position.
generic.Evidence location: Marketing risk log in SharePoint and the finance correspondence record.

steps.title: List forward-looking spend risks
sop: List media rate increases, contracted minimums and pending change orders.
Add any known vendor price escalation clauses.
Record each risk in the marketing risk log.
Done when every known risk is logged.
verify: Compare the risk list to the contract commitment schedule.
Pass when every contractual exposure appears in the log.

steps.title: Quantify each risk with a best and worst case
sop: Quantify the best case and worst case value for each risk.
State the assumed likelihood of the worst case.
Record both values and the likelihood.
Done when every risk is quantified with a likelihood.
verify: Filter risks with a missing value or likelihood.
Pass when every risk carries a quantified range and likelihood.

steps.title: Split absorbable risks from those needing funding
sop: Assess whether each risk can be absorbed inside the envelope.
Flag risks that would require additional funding.
Record the position on each risk.
Done when every risk has an absorb or fund position.
verify: List risks with no absorb or fund position.
Pass when every risk carries a funding position.

steps.title: Send the risk summary to the finance business partner
sop: Assemble the risk summary with ranges, likelihoods and positions.
Send it to the finance business partner inside the reporting window.
Record the send date and recipient.
Done when the summary is sent and recorded.
verify: Compare the send date to the reporting window deadline.
Pass when the summary was sent inside the agreed window.

steps.title: Record the finance response and agreed mitigation
sop: Capture the finance response to each risk.
Record any agreed mitigation and its owner.
Chase risks with no response received.
Done when every risk has a response or a chase record.
verify: List risks with no recorded finance response.
Pass when no communicated risk is left without a response.

steps.title: Update the risk log and set the review date
sop: Update the risk log with responses and mitigations.
Set a review date on every open risk.
Publish the updated log to marketing leadership.
Done when the log is updated and published.
verify: Open the published risk log.
Pass when every open risk shows a mitigation position and review date.

generic.Defined scope/population: The martech and agency contracts entering renewal negotiation.
generic.In-scope period: The renewal window from notice date to signature.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Agreed terms record pricing, SLA, escalation cap, notice period and effective date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Negotiated seat and tier position matches the licence reconciliation figures.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Signed contract stored in the repository with its effective date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Clauses conceded in negotiation are logged with the approval to concede.
generic.Test population: All clauses required by policy in the renewed contract.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No required data protection or audit-rights clause is dropped at renewal.
generic.Exception handling path: A dropped protection clause escalates to compliance before signature.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Executed contract records pricing, SLA, escalation cap and notice period.
generic.Evidence location: Contract lifecycle repository executed contract and negotiation file.

steps.title: Take licence reconciliation and utilisation data into the negotiation
sop: Assemble the seat reconciliation and utilisation figures.
Derive the target seat count and volume tier position.
Record the opening position for the negotiation.
Done when the data-backed opening position is set.
verify: Compare the opening position to the reconciliation figures.
Pass when the position is supported by the reconciliation data.

steps.title: Agree service levels, response times and credit remedies
sop: Negotiate the service levels and support response times.
Agree the service credit remedies for breach.
Record the agreed terms in the negotiation file.
Done when SLA and remedies are agreed.
verify: Read the draft renewal for the SLA and remedy clauses.
Pass when both are stated in the draft renewal.

steps.title: Confirm data protection and audit-rights clauses survive
sop: Compare the renewal draft to the current contract protection clauses.
Confirm data processing, use-limitation and audit rights are unchanged.
Escalate any clause the vendor proposes to drop.
Done when every protection clause is confirmed or escalated.
verify: Diff the renewal clauses against the current contract.
Pass when no required protection or audit-rights clause was dropped.

steps.title: Agree price escalation caps, notice and termination rights
sop: Negotiate the price escalation cap for the term.
Agree the notice period and termination-for-convenience right.
Record the agreed values.
Done when cap, notice and termination rights are agreed.
verify: Read the draft for the three commercial terms.
Pass when escalation cap, notice period and termination right are stated.

steps.title: Review the final terms with the budget holder
sop: Review the negotiated terms against the budget position.
Challenge any commitment beyond the approved envelope.
Approve or reject the terms for signature.
Done when the terms are approved or rejected.
verify: Open the approval record for the renewal.
Pass when the approval names the approver and the agreed value.

steps.title: Record the executed contract in the repository
sop: Store the signed contract in the contract lifecycle repository.
Record the effective date, value and notice date.
Link it to the martech inventory entry.
Done when the executed contract is stored and linked.
verify: Open the repository record for the renewal.
Pass when pricing, SLA, escalation cap and notice period are recorded.

generic.Defined scope/population: Marketing purchase orders and supplier invoices for the accounting period.
generic.In-scope period: The accounting period the invoices are posted into.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each invoice line records cost centre, campaign code and ledger account.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Invoice value matches the purchase order and delivery confirmation.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Three-way match evidence attached to each posted invoice.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Rate mismatches are held and logged with the vendor query reference.

generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No invoice is paid without a completed three-way match.
generic.Exception handling path: A rate mismatch holds payment until the vendor query is resolved.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Each posted invoice carries a matched purchase order, cost centre and campaign code.
generic.Evidence location: ERP invoice records and the workflow approval case.

steps.title: Raise the purchase order against the approved budget line
sop: Raise the purchase order in the ERP against the approved budget line.
Route it to an approver holding the required authority limit.
Record the approval reference.
Done when the purchase order is raised and approved.
verify: Compare the approver limit to the purchase order value.
Pass when the approver held the required authority limit.

steps.title: Code each invoice line to cost centre, campaign and account
sop: Open each invoice in the ERP.
Code every line to cost centre, campaign code and ledger account.
Reject lines with no valid campaign code.
Done when every invoice line is fully coded.
verify: Filter posted lines for a blank or invalid campaign code.
Pass when every posted line carries valid coding.

steps.title: Perform the three-way match
sop: Match the invoice to the purchase order.
Match it to the delivery or placement confirmation.
Attach the match evidence to the invoice record.
Done when the three-way match is complete and attached.
verify: List invoices posted with no completed match.
Pass when no invoice is paid without a completed three-way match.

steps.title: Hold and query invoices differing from the contracted rate
sop: Compare invoice rates to the contracted rate card.
Hold any invoice with a rate difference.
Raise the vendor query and record the reference.
Done when every rate difference is held and queried.
verify: List held invoices with no query reference.
Pass when every rate difference carries a vendor query.

steps.title: Post the invoice in the correct accounting period
sop: Confirm the service delivery date against the accounting period.
Post the invoice in the correct period.
Raise an accrual where service is delivered but unbilled.
Done when the invoice is posted or accrued correctly.
verify: Compare posting periods to the service delivery dates.
Pass when every invoice sits in the correct accounting period.

steps.title: Review the posted marketing invoice register
sop: Review the posted invoice register for the period.
Challenge any coding or match exception remaining.
Sign off the register for the period.
Done when the register is reviewed and signed off.
verify: Open the signed register for the period.
Pass when every posted invoice shows purchase order, cost centre and campaign.

generic.Defined scope/population: Media-buy invoices for the period and their insertion orders.
generic.In-scope period: The media flight covered by the invoiced placements.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each line records unit rate, quantity, insertion order and delivery figures.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Invoiced delivery matches the platform or broadcaster delivery report.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Delivery reports and make-good claims attached with their dates.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Under-delivery is logged with a make-good or credit claim reference.
generic.Test population: All media-buy invoice lines received for the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No unreconciled or disputed amount is released for payment.
generic.Exception handling path: A disputed balance is held separately while the claim is pursued.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Each invoice line is matched to insertion order, rate card and delivery report.
generic.Evidence location: ERP invoice records and the contract repository rate card.

steps.title: Match invoice lines to insertion order and rate card
sop: Open each media invoice line in the ERP.
Match it to the insertion order and the contracted rate card.
Check unit rate and quantity against both.
Done when every line is matched or exception flagged.
verify: List lines with no insertion order or rate card match.
Pass when every line is matched to both documents.

steps.title: Compare delivered impressions to the delivery report
sop: Retrieve the platform or broadcaster delivery report.
Compare invoiced impressions or spots to delivered figures.
Record the delivery variance per line.
Done when every line has a delivery comparison.
verify: List lines with no delivery comparison recorded.
Pass when every invoiced line is compared to delivery.

steps.title: Raise make-good or credit claims for under-delivery
sop: Identify lines with under-delivery beyond tolerance.
Raise a make-good or credit claim with the vendor.
Record the claim reference against the line.
Done when every under-delivery has a claim reference.
verify: List under-delivered lines with no claim reference.
Pass when every under-delivery carries a claim reference.

steps.title: Check agency commission and fee lines
sop: Locate agency commission and fee lines on the invoice.
Recalculate them on the contracted basis.
Query any line calculated on a different basis.
Done when every fee line is recalculated or queried.
verify: Recompute one commission line from the contracted basis.
Pass when the recomputed value matches the invoiced fee.

steps.title: Release only the reconciled amount for payment
sop: Split the invoice into reconciled and disputed amounts.
Release only the reconciled amount for payment.
Record the disputed balance separately in the ERP.
Done when the split is applied and recorded.
verify: Check the released payment against the reconciled amount.
Pass when no unreconciled or disputed amount was released.

steps.title: Review the media reconciliation position
sop: Review open claims and disputed balances for the period.
Chase vendors on aged claims.
Record the review outcome in the reconciliation file.
Done when the reconciliation position is reviewed and recorded.
verify: Open the reconciliation file for the period.
Pass when every disputed balance shows a claim and chase status.

generic.Defined scope/population: Full-year marketing spend across actuals, commitments and projected activity.
generic.In-scope period: The remaining months of the budget year from the reforecast date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each projected line records pacing basis, commitment status and value.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Actuals to date reconcile to the ledger before projection is added.

generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Lines without a pacing basis are logged and revised before submission.
generic.Test population: All budget lines carrying remaining-year spend.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No projected line is included without a stated pacing or commitment basis.
generic.Exception handling path: An unexplained movement against budget returns the line for rework.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Reforecast reconciles actuals, commitments and projected spend to the ledger.
generic.Evidence location: ERP ledger extract and the SharePoint reforecast workbook.

steps.title: Start from actual spend to date reconciled to the ledger
sop: Extract actual marketing spend to date from the ledger.
Reconcile the extract to the ledger cost centre balances.
Load the actuals into the reforecast workbook.
Done when reconciled actuals are loaded.
verify: Compare the loaded actuals to the ledger balance.
Pass when the actuals reconcile to the ledger exactly.

steps.title: Add open commitments to the position
sop: Extract open purchase orders and contracted commitments.
Add them to the actuals in the workbook.
Record the commitment source per line.
Done when open commitments are added.
verify: Compare added commitments to the open purchase order report.
Pass when the commitments agree to the purchase order report.

steps.title: Apply current pacing by channel to the remaining months
sop: Calculate current pacing per channel from the actuals.
Project the remaining months on that pacing rather than plan.
Record the pacing basis per projected line.
Done when every remaining month is projected on pacing.
verify: List projected lines with no pacing basis.
Pass when no projected line lacks a pacing or commitment basis.

steps.title: Include contracted renewals and campaign changes
sop: Add known contracted renewals falling in the remaining period.
Add agreed campaign additions and remove cancellations.
Record the source decision for each adjustment.
Done when known changes are reflected.
verify: Compare adjustments to the renewal schedule and campaign decisions.
Pass when every adjustment traces to a recorded decision.

steps.title: Reconcile the full-year projection to the approved budget

steps.title: Escalate actions past due beyond tolerance
sop: List actions past due beyond the tolerance.
Escalate each with a revised date and rationale.
Record the escalation on the action.
Done when every overdue action is escalated.
verify: List past-due actions with no escalation.
Pass when no action is past due beyond tolerance without an escalation.
